name: # Edit the `value` column to change an input; blank = use default. Open in Excel or any editor.
# DATABRICKS_PWD is intentionally NOT here - it stays in the environment / Domino secret store.
PROJECT_WORK_SCHEMA
description: Schema LOT1/LOT2-5 read & write (blank = use env / DOMINO_USER_NAME fallback)

name: DOMINO_USER_NAME
description: Personal schema; blank = Domino-injected value is used

name: # --- Study window & paths --- (dates auto-normalized to YYYY-MM-DD even if Excel reformats them)
STUDY_END
description: Study end date YYYY-MM-DD (Excel may rewrite this; the loader fixes it back)

name: MAP_DISCON_GAP_DAYS
description: Per-drug MAP-level discontinuation gap (the only 90d rule)

name: MEDICAL_DAY_SUPPLY
description: Imputed day supply for medical claims

name: ALLO_LOT_SPAN
description: ALLO LOT span: single_day or extend_to_next

name: PERSIST_TO_SCHEMA
description: Persist outputs to the work schema

name: # --- Cohort INCLUSION criteria (set FALSE to drop a rule) ---
APPLY_CE_B_INCL
description: Require continuous enrollment in the baseline period

name: APPLY_CE_F_INCL
description: Require continuous enrollment in the follow-up period

name: APPLY_NO_BL_AGENTS_INCL
description: Require no MM agents during baseline (new users)

name: # --- Cohort EXCLUSION criteria (set FALSE to drop a rule) ---
APPLY_BASELINE_MM_EXCL
description: Exclude patients with MM dx (203.0x/C90.0x) in baseline

name: # --- Orchestrator (run_pipeline.R): leave BLANK; set per-run on the command line ---
FORCE_RERUN
description: Blank = default FALSE. Set TRUE here only for a persistent override

name: SKIP_COHORT
description: Blank = default FALSE. Prefer the inline command for one-off skips

name: SKIP_LOT1
description: Blank = default FALSE. Prefer the inline command for one-off skips

name: SKIP_LOT2_5
description: Blank = default FALSE. Prefer the inline command for one-off skips

name: DRILLDOWN_MAX_PATIENTS
description: Max patients embedded in the LOT1-5 PATID drilldown
